differentiator: crawl4ai's Adaptive Crawler measures its own confidence and STOPS mid-site once it has learned enough for your query, instead of spidering every page.

concepts.name: The crawler that knows when to stop
concepts.world: A bright, clean editorial instrument panel — crawl4ai's light docs world. A confidence gauge and a spreading site map, teal on warm paper. It feels like watching a careful researcher, not a spider farm.
concepts.shows: A site fans out as a small map; only the relevant pages light teal while the rest stay gray. A confidence curve climbs alongside. It crosses the 'enough' line, the frame flips to a dark teal-lit field, and the crawl HALTS. Then the clean fit_markdown draws on, and the receipt (72k) lands.
concepts.money_shot: The confidence curve crosses the threshold and the crawl stops mid-map — an inverted dark beat so the 'stop' reads as the peak.
concepts.why_repost: It flatters the one thing Hossein actually built that nobody else bothers to show — the stopping intelligence — not the star count. A builder reposts the mechanism.
concepts.why_stop_scroll: A crawler that QUITS on purpose is a counter-intuitive image; the bright paper world is a pattern break from the dark AI-tool feed.

concepts.name: Every page vs only what matters
concepts.world: A split editorial page: a dense wall of every URL on the left, a sparse lit path on the right.
concepts.shows: The wall of pages dims to gray; a handful light up as the only ones read.
concepts.money_shot: The wall goes dark and one lit path remains.
concepts.why_repost: Clean contrast, but it leans on split_compare which 07-06 already used and reads closer to the commodity 'clean output' story.
concepts.why_stop_scroll: Strong contrast, but less singular than the stopping idea.

concepts.name: Markdown out of noise
concepts.world: A messy webpage morphing into clean markdown.
concepts.shows: HTML soup resolves into tidy fit_markdown.
concepts.why_repost: Weakest — this is exactly the rejected default; every scraper claims it, and it hides the adaptive intelligence.

picked: The crawler that knows when to stop
wow_bets: the confidence curve crossing the 'enough' line and the crawl HALTING (inverted dark money beat)
the selective site map: relevant pages light teal, the rest stay gray — the crawler choosing
a bright warm-paper world that reads clean at a glance in a sunlit room (no dark-room type)
light_plan: Bright light canvas holds every scene far above the brightness floor. Each scene owns a bright graphic focal element in dark ink or saturated teal: the wordmark + page cards (s1), the lit teal nodes (s2), the drawing curve (s3), the markdown plate (s4), the glowing curve at the threshold (s5), the count-up numeral (s6), the thesis wordmark (s7). The renderer has no per-scene polarity flip, so the run stays all-light on purpose — the whole point of the flip is to answer 'every video seems dark.'
color_script: Warm paper world throughout with teal as the single saturated pop. The contrast beats are teal-saturation and camera dynamics (the curve and lit nodes against cream), not a dark/light value swing — a light editorial run is the deliberate opposite of the last two dark videos.
cut_plan: Hard cuts throughout (no dissolve). Motion carries through each cut: the curve is already drawing when scene 3 enters, the map is already spreading when scene 2 enters. The one foley riser_braam button lands on the STOP; no swipe between scenes.
